page.layout: One page of text: a tree diagram (synopsis) filling the page, with the vertical label "GESTVS seu habitus" at the left beside the main brace. The word "ETHICA" stands at the lower right as a running head. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.l: quoad hominem totum vel partes ejusdem.

page.notes: The diagram is a brace tree; the levels follow the depth of the braces. The faint lines and words in the background are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The right-hand brace column ("congruo, decoro, tempestivo") and the "lugendo, laetando, operando" column are read as children of "motu/vestitu" and "Consuetudinarius" respectively, as the braces indicate.
